title: UK government updates FCDO confidentiality policy for official statistics
excerpt: The Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office updated its policy to align with the third edition of the Code of Practice for Statistics.
bodyHtml:
The UK government announced on November 6, 2026, that it has updated its confidentiality policy regarding the Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO) statistics. The policy outlines how the department protects personal information used in the production of official statistics.

This update ensures the department maintains compliance with data protection law and the Code of Practice for Statistics. The revised statement reflects the requirements of the Code of Practice for Statistics Edition 3.0, which mandates that producers of statistics manage data securely and remain transparent about data usage.

The Code of Practice for Statistics requires producers of statistics to manage data and statistics safely and securely. Producers must also be open about how data will be used and protected. The FCDO first published its confidentiality policy on 1 March 2024.
